scope: V850 target plans plus explicit loader-count hypothesis, NOT effective state/readback

input_eq.counts_boundary: Loader PM counts, not proof no indirect writer or live change exists.

delay.mapping: direct slot order, NOT output config permutation68B30

mode_boundary: A80B8 requests mode1 for masters; AC248 initializes fanout mode/ramp fields. These are not silently converted to effective state. Current gain, effective mode/rates and histories remain required.

master.boundary: Mode1 requires explicit previous-mode/previous-target/time/step state in SecondBAuxReference; no substituted mode or inferred current state.

fanout.boundary: Successful control writes only, no current state or delivery proof.
